title: EVALUATING AND IMPROVING CULTURAL AWARENESS OF REWARD MODELS FOR LLM ALIGNMENT
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures cultural awareness across four domains: cultural commonsense knowledge, values, safety, and linguistics. It does not specifically measure aspects of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on secular cultural awareness (e.g., national customs, values, linguistic nuances).
